questions.qtext: Find the number of complements for the element 'a'.
questions.solution:
Answer: B

Selected solution (score: 4)
Only complement of "a" is "i". ( a ^ i = j and a v i = f )
Source solution 2 (score: 3)
Complement of an element a is b if ....... a v b =1(Greatest).....and .....a ^b =0(least).......

So in the Given Question there is only 1 element that is i for which ......a v i=f.....and a ^ i=j......

So the correct answer is 1.

questions.qtext: Let $L$ be a lattice. Then for every $a$ and $b$ in $L$ which one of the following is correct?
questions.solution:
Answer: B

Source solution 1 (score: 0)

Answer: B
Every lattice satisfies the following laws

  1. Commutativity

    a∨b=b∨a
    a∧b=b∧a

  2. Associativity

    a∨(b∨c)=(a∨b)∨c
    a∧(b∧c)=(a∧b)∧c

  3. Idempotency

    a∨a=a
    a∧a=a

  4. Absorption

    a∨(a∧b)=a
    a∧(a∨b)=a

This is the standard Boolean lattice where $c^{-1}=b$ and $b^{-1}=c$ and $b∧c⪯$ {b,c} $⪯ b∨c$

As given, $b∧c^{-1} =0$ (Here 0 is the least element ) $⇒$ $b∧c^{-1} =b∧c$

$⇒$ $b∧b =b∧c $ $(c^{-1}=b)$

$⇒$$ b =b∧c $ $(b∧b=b)$

$⇒$ {$b∧c= b$} $⪯ c$

Answer (A)
